async function haveFiveRawIronIntoIronIngotsTask(bot) {
    // This process checks if the bot already possesses five iron ingots. If not, it determines how many more are required and verifies that enough raw iron is available. It then locates or places a furnace block nearby. Next, it searches for a suitable fuel source to cover the smelting needs. Finally, it smelts the necessary raw iron into ingots and confirms that the target amount has been reached.
